role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 有了水晶室女，盟友的魔法将源源不断，敌人的死亡在她的减速下得到了保障，对于任何团队，她都是有力的帮手。良机出现之时，她还将发动大规模的终极技能给敌人带去毁灭。
hero_summary_en: Able to keep her allies supplied with mana as she slows down enemies to ensure a kill, Crystal Maiden is a helpful addition to any team. And, when the opportunity arises, she can unleash her massive ultimate ability to devastate her foes.

abilities.name: crystal_maiden_crystal_nova
abilities.description_zh: 召唤具有破坏性的冰爆，降低目标区域内的敌人的移动速度。
abilities.description_en: A burst of damaging frost slows enemy movement in the targeted area.
notes_zh: 冰霜新星在持续时间内提供目标区域的视野。
notes_en: Crystal Nova provides vision in the targeted area for the duration.
facet_text_en: Crystal Nova has increased radius and grants allied heroes a physical damage barrier. Barrier is increased for Crystal Maiden.
facet_text_zh: 冰霜新星拥有更大的作用范围，并且为友方英雄提供一个物理伤害护盾。水晶室女身上的护盾数值更高。

abilities.name: crystal_maiden_frostbite
abilities.description_zh: 操控冰霜包围一个敌方单位，禁止移动和攻击，并持续造成伤害。对非远古的普通单位施放将造成%creep_multiplier%倍伤害。
abilities.description_en: Encases an enemy unit in ice, prohibiting movement and attack, while dealing damage over time. Deals %creep_multiplier%x damage to non-ancient creeps.

abilities.name: crystal_maiden_brilliance_aura
abilities.description_zh: 地图上所有友方单位获得额外魔法恢复。水晶室女附近%proximity_bonus_radius%范围内友军获得更高的魔法恢复。水晶室女被动获得魔法恢复增强。
abilities.description_en: Gives mana regeneration to all friendly units on the map. Allies within a %proximity_bonus_radius% radius of Crystal Maiden receive more mana regeneration.Crystal Maiden passively gains mana regen amplification.
facet_text_en: Activating Arcane Aura temporarily increases Crystal Maiden's spell amplification and mana costs. During the duration, Crystal Maiden restores her own and her allies' Mana when casting spells. Does not affect items. Duration is paused while channeling Freezing Field.
facet_text_zh: 主动开启奥术光环会临时提升水晶室女的技能增强，但技能的魔法消耗也会增加。在持续时间内，只要水晶室女施放技能，她和她的友军都会回复魔法。不会影响物品。极寒领域的持续施法期间持续时间会暂停。

abilities.name: crystal_maiden_crystal_clone
abilities.description_zh: 向一个方向滑行，在原地制造一个自身的冰晶克隆，并且躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道。如果克隆受到了足量伤害，或者超过一定时间都会碎裂，对附近%frostbite_radius%范围内敌人施加冰封禁制。克隆体也可以被水晶室女自身的技能摧毁。
abilities.description_en: Slides in a direction, creating a crystal clone of herself in her place and disjointing incoming projectiles. If the clone takes enough damage or times out, it shatters, Frostbiting enemies in a %frostbite_radius% AoE around its place. The Clone can also be destroyed by Crystal Maiden's own spells.

abilities.name: crystal_maiden_glacial_guard
abilities.description_zh: 水晶室女消耗在她技能上的一部分魔法会转化为物理护盾。
abilities.description_en: A portion of the mana Crystal Maiden spends on her abilities is converted into a physical barrier.

abilities.name: crystal_maiden_freezing_field
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 以水晶室女为中心召唤%num_explosions%次随机冰爆轰炸敌人，将其减速并造成大量伤害。持续%abilitychanneltime%秒。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Surrounds Crystal Maiden with %num_explosions% random icy explosions that slow enemies and deal massive damage. Lasts %abilitychanneltime% seconds.
notes_zh: 减速效果对作用范围内所有敌人有效，即使他们没有受到冰爆的伤害（效果持续%slow_duration%秒）。
notes_en: The slow is applied on all enemies in the radius, even if they aren't hit by an explosion (lasts %slow_duration% second).

scepter_loc.en: Allows you to move, cast and attack during Freezing Field. Can still be interrupted by enemies. You move %shard_self_movement_speed_slow_pct%%% slower during this. Increases total number of explosions by %shard_bonus_explosion%%%. Applies Frostbite to any unit that has been standing in the Freezing Field for over %frostbite_delay%s.
scepter_loc.zh: 使自身在极寒领域期间可以移动、施法和攻击。仍然可以被敌人打断。在此期间移动速度降低%shard_self_movement_speed_slow_pct%%%。冰爆总数提升%shard_bonus_explosion%%%。对极寒领域内停留超过%frostbite_delay%秒的所有单位都会施加冰封禁制。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_crystal_maiden_glacial_guard_mana_multiplier
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_mana_multiplier}% Glacial Guard Mana Spent To Barrier
